policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'the powers that be are ordained of God' renders the participle alone as a substantive; an explicit ἐξουσίαι would produce the identical English, and no ASV note is mapped here.
The variant is the article with θεοῦ; ASV 'ordained of God' cannot show the presence or absence of a Greek article, and no note is mapped here.
ASV reads 'are not a terror to the good work' — a singular dative object matching τῷ ἀγαθῷ ἔργῳ; RP's genitive plural τῶν ἀγαθῶν ἔργων would give 'a terror of good works'.
ASV 'but to the evil' continues the dative construction of 'to the good work' in the same clause, matching τῷ κακῷ rather than RP's genitive plural τῶν κακῶν.
ASV begins the verse 'Render to all their dues' with no inferential connective; RP's ἀπόδοτε οὖν would be rendered 'Render therefore', as ASV does elsewhere for οὖν.
The variant is Greek word order only; ASV 'save to love one another' is the same English for either sequence, and the mapped note is a greek_gloss on 'neighbor', not on this unit.
The variant is the position of τούτῳ relative to τῷ λόγῳ; ASV 'summed up in this word' renders either order identically, and the mapped note is a cross-reference.
ASV's 'namely,' introducing the quotation is a supplied English connective that neither requires nor excludes ἐν τῷ before Ἀγαπήσεις; no textual_variant note is mapped here.

ASV 'it is time for you to awake out of sleep' is second person, matching ὑμᾶς; both ἡμᾶς readings (Treg, RP) would give 'for us to awake', and ASV's later 'nearer to us' shows it distinguishes the two pronouns in this verse.
ASV 'let us therefore cast off the works of darkness' fits ἀποβαλώμεθα and ἀποθώμεθα alike, both meaning to throw off or put away; no note is mapped here.
The variant is δέ following the verb versus καί preceding it; ASV 'and let us put on the armor of light' renders either connective the same way.
